title: Better Birch Blocks
description: This texture pack makes Birch appear in a yellow-ish color. Hopefully this will make you like Birch more, because I know it's sure makes me. If you don't enjoy this change, then of course feel free to not download it.
body:
# Better Birch Blocks!  
A resource pack that makes Birch-related blocks have a yellow-ish and hopefully better appearing texture.  
Though unlikely, I may update this in the future. I also create addons for Bedrock Edition, so I may release a bedrock version of this texture pack.  

--------------------------------
## Created by NightML aka NightMareLore.
## I hope you enjoy!  
## Please don't feel inclined to download this resource pack. Only get it if it resonates with you and/or your build style.
--------------------------------
